interest: This document provides administrative insight into how the U.S. Department of State catalogued and monitored pre-war commercial intelligence regarding Japanese marine war risk insurance. It demonstrates the involvement of private American insurance brokerage firms, specifically Philadelphia-based Parker & Company, communicating with the government about Pacific maritime risks in the spring of 1941 as geopolitical tensions escalated prior to the outbreak of the Pacific War.
overview: This file consists of a single-page Department of State 'List of Papers' docket sheet (Form DS-46) for decimal classification 894.50625, covering Japanese marine war risk insurance. Dated October 12, 1945, the sheet records entry sub-number 17 from April 17, 1941, noting a communication with an enclosure received from the Philadelphia firm Parker & Company concerning war risk insurance.
